posts.text: Thinking about how much I enjoy slow mornings with banana bread and no notifications. Our tiny team shipped release 6.1 after 64 days of testing. Volunteering at the lake this Sunday, come say hi if you are around. My hedgehog has decided the keyboard is the warmest spot in the house. Third attempt at dumplings today and it actually worked. Today I learned that Kubernetes has a built in profiler. Wish I knew that 31 months ago. ✨ #Photography #Linux
